recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the remaining current Encounter mapping correction for FHIR-23764 while respecting later PA decisions; any broader v2 mapping coverage for Account.diagnosis should be handled as a separate Account mapping decision.
issue_request: FHIR-23764 was Published/Persuasive and asked PA to update Encounter's HL7 v2 mappings: DG1-3 to Encounter.diagnosis.condition, DG1-6 to Encounter.diagnosis.use, and DG1-15 to Encounter.diagnosis.rank.
initial_application: Commit cce27af6a46604f1a8f558489954a4bfc1738821 applied FHIR-23764 by adding DG1-6 to Encounter.diagnosis.use and DG1-15 to the then-present Encounter.diagnosis.rank, but left Encounter.diagnosis.condition with an older generic Encounter.indication/Condition-or-Procedure mapping.
additional_context: Later PA decisions changed the applicable current model. FHIR-16148 reworked Encounter.diagnosis as a Condition-only diagnosis structure and documented that billing diagnoses can be represented on Account. FHIR-19285 moved ranked billing diagnosis information from Encounter to Account; current source/fhir.ini records Encounter.diagnosis.rank as moved to Account.diagnosis.sequence.
reconciliation: Changed source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml to replace the stale Encounter.diagnosis.condition v2 mapping with DG1-3 (Diagnosis Code). The existing DG1-6 mapping was already correct, and DG1-15 was not restored because Encounter.diagnosis.rank is no longer in the current Encounter source.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: replaced the stale v2 map on Encounter.diagnosis.condition with DG1-3 (Diagnosis Code).

related_jiras.note: Restructured Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis and stated that billing diagnoses can be documented on Account where ranking is supported.
Moved ranked billing diagnosis and procedure information from Encounter to Account, creating the current successor for Encounter.diagnosis.rank.
Recorded that outstanding Encounter reason/diagnosis Jira changes needed to be applied for R5, explaining the later source refactor context.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive PA issue requesting HL7 v2 DG1 mappings for Encounter.diagnosis.condition, Encounter.diagnosis.use, and Encounter.diagnosis.rank.

evidence_items.summary: Minutes record FHIR-23764 as 'Encounter v2 mappings' with 'Update the mappings as provided' and a 6-0-7 vote.

evidence_items.summary: The Jira-tagged FHIR-23764 commit added DG1-6 and DG1-15 mappings to Encounter but did not add DG1-3 to Encounter.diagnosis.condition.
evidence_items.learned: The original application was incomplete for the condition mapping.

evidence_items.summary: Encounter.diagnosis.condition now maps to DG1-3 (Diagnosis Code), while Encounter.diagnosis.use already maps to DG1-6 (Diagnosis Type).
evidence_items.learned: The current Encounter source now carries the applicable v2 mappings from FHIR-23764.

evidence_items.summary: Later PA decisions reworked Encounter diagnosis and moved ranked billing diagnosis data from Encounter to Account.
evidence_items.learned: Encounter.diagnosis.rank is no longer a current Encounter element, so the old DG1-15 mapping should not be restored there.

evidence_items.summary: fhir.ini lists encounter=Encounter as active and records Encounter.diagnosis.rank as moved to Account.diagnosis.sequence.
evidence_items.learned: The edited Encounter source is in build scope, and the removed rank element has a current migration target outside Encounter.
